summary: Executed source independent history-read controls on JSON, SQLite and remote PostgreSQL 16.14. Eleven library/receipt/security routes contain known store loss with opaque 503 JSON, including failed CSV reads. Four composite SQL details reuse only an owned same-repository snapshot; real concurrent commits cannot mix generations. Missing-table faults propagate through exports and contained nested errors explicitly roll back without losing the original error. Existing empty/missing/auth/filter/cache responses remain intact. No writes are retried or volatile-library persistence added. Installed GUI, multi-request snapshots and large-history performance remain open.
